html:
Rounding Whole Numbers

Locate the requested place and look one digit to its right. A digit from 0 to 4 keeps the rounding-place digit; a digit from 5 to 9 increases it by one. Replace digits to the right with zeros.

Worked example

Round 46,782 to the nearest thousand. The hundreds digit is 7, so the result is 47,000. To the nearest ten thousand, the result is 50,000.

Watch out

The requested place changes the answer. Do not round one place at a time in a chain.
